reviews.review_msg: Love his classes so much!! Everything is interesting and manageable, never felt it was a pressure to study with. But the MCQ questions are so confused but not hard, you just need to guess which ones are the most correct and focus on the slides not the textbook.

Very disorganized. Doesn't respond to emails. Assignments have multiple outlines/rubrics that aren't consistent and lack clarity. Due dates keep changing and are inconsistent across assignment materials. I would avoid.

Andrei always brings a smile when he walks in the room. The midterm was lecture heavy, with somewhere between 2-4 MCQ from the textbook. He is new though, and is not tech savvy with canvas leading to mixed questions when it comes to guidelines. The biggest grade decider is the group work
This prof is excellent, he is funny tho and really passionate to share great experience in this class
